text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Government rejects (Catalan leader Jordi) Pujol offer to mediate in labour reform
- State of emergency in Albania to halt popular revolt
- Bullfighting strike was total in Castellon
- Ex-PP (Popular Party) directors from Zamora denounce party for taking illegal commissions
EL MUNDO
- (Ex-chairman Banesto Mario) Conde on trial today accused of expropriating 600 million
- (Socialist party) PSOE leaders compete in making fun of the government on the anniversary of March 3 (election)
- 10 firebombs launched at house of a Navarre region Socialist deputy
- High court seized a video of Gestures (For Amnesty) one year after it was requisitioned in a prison
DIARIO 16
- Irresponsible judges: judicial mistakes cost 120 million; 30 Spaniards suffered preventive prison and were absolved in court; no judge has had to compensate victims
- Banker Mario Conde sits in defendent's stand for the first time
ABC
- Autonomous regions have multiplied their debt by six in the last 10 years
- Unions warn that there will be no labour reform if the CEOE (employers' group) does not cede on dismissals
CINCO DIAS
- 14,000 ex-priests to get pensions; the government will compensate cloistered religious people who have not paid social security
- The regulation for companies exempts retention for loans between linked companies
- New frontier arrives in pharmaceutical sector: doctors will prescribe main active ingredients, not brands
EXPANSION
- (Economy minister Rodrigo) Rato profiles a plan to dissipate the fears of the European "hawks"
- Pujol wants to mediate in labour reform
- (Bank) Sabadell defends its leadership in funds
- Adolfo Dominguez fixes the share price between 2,650 and 3,100
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Electricity sector profits rise 11 percent despite price freeze
- PP takes a measure of the first anniversary of its electoral victory
- Adolfo Dominguez puts six million shares on sale from today
